standard_prerequisites.name: A quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme with the resolution property has affine diagonal

For a scheme with affine diagonal, any map in the derived category between complexes of quasi-coherent modules is represented by an actual map of complexes after pullback along a quasi-isomorphism, and equal derived maps become homotopic maps of complexes
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the initial resolution G^bullet with homotopy h witnessing the equality.

standard_prerequisites.name: Any bounded complex of quasi-coherent modules on a scheme with the resolution property receives a quasi-isomorphism from a bounded complex of finite locally free modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Replaces the truncated quasi-coherent resolution by a perfect complex, finishing the proof.

core_obligations: By Lemma resolution-property-affine-diagonal the scheme X has affine diagonal; hence by Proposition quasi-compact-affine-diagonal there is a quasi-isomorphism gamma^bullet : G^bullet to E^bullet with G^bullet a complex of quasi-coherent modules such that alpha^bullet gamma^bullet and beta^bullet gamma^bullet are homotopic; choose the homotopy h^i : G^i to F^{i-1} (proof lines 9966-9979).

Choose n much less than 0; since E^bullet is bounded, gamma^bullet factors canonically over the quotient G^bullet to tau_{>= n} G^bullet, and for the same reason the homotopy maps h^i factor over the surjections G^i to (tau_{>= n} G)^i; so G^bullet may be replaced by the bounded below truncation tau_{>= n} G^bullet (proof lines 9979-9985).

Apply Lemma construct-strictly-perfect to the bounded complex tau_{>= n} G^bullet of quasi-coherent modules to obtain a quasi-isomorphism from a bounded complex of finite locally free modules, which composed with the truncation gives the required gamma^bullet (proof lines 9985-9987).
proof_roadmap: Get an initial quasi-coherent resolution equalizing the two maps up to homotopy via the affine diagonal proposition (proof lines 9966-9979).
Truncate from below using boundedness of E^bullet; the homotopy factors as well (proof lines 9979-9985).
Replace by a finite locally free complex via construct-strictly-perfect (proof lines 9985-9987).
